closed_prior_findings.resolution: Fresh v004 front, top, aerial and rear-side pixels show uninterrupted grey roof coverage to both verges. Buff/black exposed strips and crossing masonry rows are absent. Side elevations retain seated gables and ridge without new open slots.

pixel_observations: Three-storey buff entrance bar retains the source-specific sequence of four shallow segmental arches, outer balcony pairs, intermediate narrow windows, gable silhouette and three rooflights per slope. Adjacent red courtyard blocks are excluded transparently.

Whole front, left, right, rear and rear-side views show a grounded complete envelope with coherent window grammar and preserved balcony projections. Neutral camera margins include the complete base and roof.
Top/aerial/roof-contact views show closed longitudinal gable coverage, bounded ridge/eaves, and rooflight frames seated in physical roof openings. The previous exposed verge strips are now closed.
Fine staggered masonry remains readable on wall, gable and arch-pier surfaces. Semantic buff masonry, dark railings/frames and grey roof remain coherent for the architectural-clay profile.
Facade/glass/side-projection views retain cut returns, recessed paired glazed balcony doors and muted offset residential interior depth. Balcony rails terminate on slabs and slabs meet the masonry.

Architecture-close and passage-axis views show two clear through-passages with continuous floor, enclosed sidewalls/ceilings and rear exits; outer arches contain recessed entry vestibules. No new blockage or disconnected access appeared after roof repair.

All three exact source images, all fourteen final 1440x1080 renders and all four final boards were directly reopened. Phone boards retain the entrance-bar identity and visible connections; no board was used instead of individual render inspection.
limitations: Architectural-clay approval only; no textured keeper, engineering, survey, code or accessibility certification.
Rear apartment rhythm, rear doors, interior partitions and stairs are declared inference. This is one entrance bar, not a complete enclosed courtyard development.
Use complete native bounds including balcony projections; no arbitrary mesh stretching, floor repetition or sibling substitution.

Sol must still verify Currie terrain contact, placement/collision envelope, ground-entry sidewalk connections, unobstructed passage approaches, edits, undo/reload and exports. No runtime entrance anchors are approved by this asset review.
No browser checks, seeding, paid calls, geometry edits or repository edits performed by reviewer.
